doc.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07

title: De De's band with Paul Barnes
summary: About 30 years ago he played with Paul Barnes; he names the saxophonists and second trumpet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, let's see. When did you work with Paul Barnes? I don't know. I don't know. I don't know.
We've been married 24 years and we'd wait a good while before we got married.
I had the same boy I mentioned, Rochon, Wright. I had a picard of Jackson Hill. What is that?
I was looking at it, got my seat out of it.
Myself, and the Shelley Lamelle trumpet player, second trumpet player to me. I think he might still be playing.
Is he from out in the country?
Here, here's one of those cards I was working at the Coop in the Grove here. That's launched until I was...
Shelley's from here. I think he might be playing in Spots now. Might be. I'm not sure.
